title: The Time of the Judges
lead: The era between Joshua's conquest and the first kings, roughly 1200–1050 BC on the chronology most historians use, or from about 1380 BC on the chronology of 1 Kings 6:1. Israel was a loose union of tribes, led in crises by "judges" such as Deborah, Gideon and Samson. The book of Judges paints it as a time of repeated unfaithfulness; Ruth shows faithfulness in the same years.
